name: The Bard
palette: Warm palette of velvet purple, deep wine red and candlelight gold, with glowing golden musical notes.
character: THE BARD: a charismatic, theatrical young man in a velvet purple doublet and a feathered cap, short cape, carrying a battered three-string lute; glowing golden musical notes swirl in the air around him.
icon_subject: the Bard's face under his feathered cap, grinning, front view
portrait: full portrait of the Bard striking a heroic pose on a tavern table, lute raised, notes swirling
banner: The Bard playing his lute at the foot of a dark spire, golden music notes rising up its walls

overrides.worn_lute: a battered three-string lute with a crack in its body, warm gold glow
overrides.battle_hymn_power: a war banner with a golden musical note emblem
overrides.lullaby_power: a crescent moon wrapped in drifting musical notes
overrides.requiem_power: a black candle with musical notes rising as smoke
overrides.dirge_power: a cracked skull crowned with dark musical notes
overrides.strike_bard: A battered wooden three-string lute with a small crack, swung like a club diagonally from lower left to upper right through a wide golden sound-wave arc; glowing golden music notes burst from the point of impact.
